request.spec: Show money properly everywhere. Use a dollar sign and cents, like $100.00.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show money properly everywhere. Use a dollar sign and cents, like $100.00.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes.

I made the change request "Show money properly everywhere" by adding a dollar sign (while keeping the two-decimal cents) to every money display in the app:

- `src/main/frontend/features/projects/ProjectInvoices.tsx` — invoice amounts (`invoice-amount`) and the project total (`project-invoices-total`) now render like `$100.00` / `$150.00`.
- `src/main/frontend/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx` — the dashboard outstanding total (`dashboard-outstanding-total`) now renders the same way.

This is a UI-display-only change, consistent with the spec's note that the stored/audited amount format is unchanged (the paid-invoice audit still records `amount=100.00`), so no schema migration or server change was needed — those layers still carry the raw numeric value, and only the presentation layer formats it. No `data-testid` was renamed or removed. The one installed Playwright spec passes (1 passed).
